title: Rendered accessibility evidence boundaries
prompt: Read-only reasoning exercise. Do not change files, access real user data or claim execution. Nominal tokens and a screenshot look acceptable, but a masked close control disappears under forced colors. Reduced-motion styling hides the entire loading status. Dismissing the notice leaves focus without a useful owner. The author claims accessibility conformance from source checks. Review and design discriminating checks.

checks.reason: Advisory signal only; the rubric judges decisions rather than keyword presence.

rubric: Require a visible close affordance, accessible name, keyboard operation and distinguishable focus under forced colors.
Retain loading information when decorative animation stops, and restore focus after dismissal.
Pair controlled defect rejection with restored positive cases.
Distinguish source checks, browser observations and unavailable assistive technology; do not claim conformance from tokens or screenshots alone.
acceptance: The response makes the specified contextual decisions, proposes discriminating observations and states evidence limits without inventing execution.
